avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

lines.label: Road
lines.text: SR 20 North Cascade Highway is open as of Sunday, June 14. Traditionally, weather and road conditions are reported from November 1 to April 1. Should adverse weather occur that will impact travel, updates will be provided as information is available.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations between 12 days earlier and 5 days later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Rainy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 2; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), June 6 (2024), June 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 6 (2023), April 13 (2024), April 14 (2025)

evidence.name: Park Creek Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 20 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Rainy Pass (4,880 ft), the second highest at Swamp Creek (3,930 ft) and the lowest at Park Creek Ridge (4,610 ft).

evidence.name: Park Creek Ridge

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 16 and July 24, carried from the melt-out dates at Rainy Pass (4,880 ft) and Park Creek Ridge (4,610 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Rainy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 2, 1,583 ft below the pass; points to May 27 to August 2

evidence.name: Park Creek Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 1,853 ft below the pass; points to May 5 to July 15
